title: Privacy Policy
intro: {companyName} processes personal data when you browse this shop, create an account, place an order, or contact us. VAT {vat}. Contact: {email}. Address: {address}. Phone: {phone}.
section1Body: {companyName} is the controller of personal data collected through this shop. For privacy questions, write to {email}.
section2Body: We collect account details (name, email, phone), shipping and billing addresses, order history, and technical data such as device type and pages visited.
section3Body: We use this information to fulfil orders, manage your account, process payments, prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations.
section4Body: We do not sell personal data. We share it with payment, shipping, and hosting providers only as needed to operate the shop, and when required by law.
section5Body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data, and you may object to certain processing. Contact {email} to exercise these rights.
